title: Can Its Own Misses Teach an MLLM to Find Small Brain Metastases?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are becoming general readers of medical images, yet they remain weak at locating small abnormalities. Brain metastases expose this gap: at 384 px a 0.1 mL lesion covers less than a quarter of one visual token, and at one false positive per scan frontier MLLMs find fewer than 30% of lesions of 0.1-1 mL. Fine-tuning on one dataset helps but transfers poorly, and improving it further is slow trial and error steered by a single score. We introduce LANTERN (Lesion-finding AgeNt Through Error-driven Recursive learNing), a framework in which an MLLM improves recursively from its own misses. translated_title: MLLM能否从自身的漏检中学会发现小体积脑转移瘤？
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）正在成为医学图像的通用阅读器，但它们在定位小体积异常方面仍然表现薄弱。脑转移瘤正是暴露这一差距的典型案例：在384像素分辨率下，一个0.1 mL的病灶覆盖的面积不足单个视觉token的四分之一，而在每次扫描仅允许一个假阳性的条件下，前沿MLLM对0.1-1 mL病灶的检出率不足30%。在单一数据集上微调虽然有所帮助，但跨数据集迁移能力差，而进一步提升的过程是由单一分数引导的缓慢试错。我们提出了LANTERN（通过错误驱动递归学习的病灶发现智能体），这是一个让MLLM从自身漏检中递归改进的框架。LANTERN将模型开发重构为一个错误驱动的循环：失败普查将每一个漏检病灶归因于四种原因之一，一位LLM导师在每一轮对四个层面之一（证据获取、视觉表征、学习策略、决策聚合）进行修订，并在第一轮之前冻结的规则决定……
tldr: 该论文提出LANTERN框架，通过把MLLM漏检脑转移瘤的失败原因归为四类，并由LLM导师在证据获取、视觉表征、学习策略和决策聚合四个层面递归修订，实现模型从自身错误中迭代提升小病灶检测能力。
en_tdlr: LANTERN is an error-driven recursive learning framework that lets an MLLM improve small brain metastasis detection by attributing its own misses to four failure causes and having an LLM mentor revise one of four levels—evidence acquisition, visual representation, learning policy, or decision aggregation—at each iteration.
